spans.s: यन्तृ m. 1. A governor, a ruler, a manager; 2. a driver, a charioteer, अथ यन्तारमादिश्य धुर्यान्विश्रामयेति सः R.i.54; 3. an elephant-driver.

यंत्र् vt. 1U, 10U (pp. यंत्रित; pres. यंत्रति-ते, यंत्रयति-ते) To restrain, to bind, to confine, शापयंत्रिरपौलस्त्यबलात्कारकचग्रहैः R.x.47.With नि-, to restrain, to chain.With सम्-, to stop, to check, संयन्त्रितो मया रथः Sak.vii.

यंत्र n. 1. A prop, a support, गृहयंत्रपताकाश्रीरपौरादरनिर्मिता K.S.vi.41; 2. a fetter, a cord, a fastening; 3. any instrument or machine, a contrivance, हिंस्रयंत्रविधानं च व्यसनान्यात्मविक्रमः Yaj.iii.240; 4. a surgical instrument, especially any blunt instrument, (op. to शस्त्र); 5. a lock, a bolt; 6. restraint, force; 7. an amulet, a mystical diagram used as a charm.
यंत्र-उपल n. a mill-stone, a mill.
यंत्र-करंडिका f. a kind of magical basket.
यंत्र-कर्मकृत् m. an artizan.
यंत्र-गृह n. an oil-mill, a manufactory.
यंत्र-चेष्टित n. any magical operation.
यंत्र-नाल n. a mechanical pipe or tube.
यंत्र-पुत्रक m. a mechanical doll, a puppet fitted with any contrivance to move the limbs.
यंत्र-पुत्रिका f. a mechanical doll, a puppet fitted with any contrivance to move the limbs.
यंत्र-प्रवाह m. a machine for watering.
यंत्र-मार्ग m. an aqueduct, a canal.
यंत्र-शर m. a missile shot off by machinery.
यंत्रक (I) m. One acquainted with machinery.
यंत्रक (II) n. 1. A bandage (in medicine); 2. a turner’s lathe.

यंत्रण n. 1. Restriction, restraint, ह्रीयंत्रणामानशिरे मनोज्ञामन्योन्यलोलानि विलोचनानि R.vii.23, K.S.vii.175; 2. fastening, निबिडपीनकुचद्वययंत्रणा तमपराधमधात् प्रतिबध्नती Na.iv.10; 3. constraint, pain, anguish, अलमलमुपचारयंत्रणया Mal.v.; 4. guarding, protecting (only n. in this sense).

यंत्रणा f. 1. Restriction, restraint, ह्रीयंत्रणामानशिरे मनोज्ञामन्योन्यलोलानि विलोचनानि R.vii.23, K.S.vii.175; 2. fastening, निबिडपीनकुचद्वययंत्रणा तमपराधमधात् प्रतिबध्नती Na.iv.10; 3. constraint, pain, anguish, अलमलमुपचारयंत्रणया Mal.v.; 4. guarding, protecting (only n. in this sense).
यंत्रणी f. A wife’s younger sister.
यंत्रणी f. A wife’s younger sister.
यंत्रिन् m. 1. A horse furnished with harness or trappings; 2. a tormentor; 3. one having an amulet.

यान n. 1. Marching, attacking, M.vii.160, 2. going, a journey, a voyage, समुदयानकुशला देशकालार्थदर्शिनः M.viii.157; 3. a procession; 4. a carriage, a chariot, a vehicle in general, यानादवातरददूरमहीतलेन R.xiii.69, K.S.vi.76.
यान-पात्र n. a ship, a boat.
यान-भंग m. shipwreck.
यान-मुख n. the yoke of a carriage.
